quotes.text: 5. ¿Qué parentesco tiene con la jefa o jefe del hogar?
quotes.document: [C] CUESTIONARIO V9_bol_partir del cuarto trimestre de 2024.pdf

assessments.reasoning: Question 5 records the relationship of each household member to the head of household ("jefa o jefe del hogar"). However, the questionnaire text does not establish a method for identifying who the household head is (whether self-declared by the household, designated by the respondent, or assigned by an explicit criterion). Therefore, as instructed when the instrument does not establish a method, the selection is left empty.
